title: Self Adhesive Plastic Wire Cable Organizer Clips for Home and Office (20 Pieces)
description:
Keep your home and office tidy with these convenient self-adhesive plastic cable organizer clips. Designed to manage charging wires, USB cords, and other everyday cables, these clips help eliminate clutter and tangles. Each clip features multiple slots to keep cords neatly separated and easily accessible. The strong self-adhesive backing ensures quick and easy installation on any clean, smooth, and dry surface, without the need for drilling. Their compact design ensures efficient cable routing without taking up valuable space, making them ideal for desks, walls, and appliance areas.

Key features

  • Multiple holding slots keep several everyday cables neatly separated and organised.
  • Self-adhesive backing allows for quick, drill-free installation on smooth surfaces.
  • Effectively reduces loose wires and clutter around your workspace.
  • Compact design ensures minimal space usage for an uncluttered look.
  • Perfect for charging cables, USB cords, and various other wires.
  • Smooth, rounded holders facilitate convenient cable placement and removal.
  • Creates an organised cable-routing arrangement for a safer environment.
  • Durable plastic construction offers long-lasting cable management.

Materials & care

Material: Plastic

Care Instructions: Ensure the mounting surface is clean, smooth, and dry before application. Press the clip firmly after positioning and allow the adhesive to settle for a few hours before attaching cables. Avoid using on rough, dusty, wet, or uneven surfaces to ensure optimal adhesion. Do not overload the holders with excessively thick or heavy cables.

FAQ

Q1: How do these self-adhesive cable organizer clips work?
A: These clips feature a strong self-adhesive backing that allows them to be easily attached to clean, smooth surfaces. They have multiple slots to hold and separate various cables, preventing tangles and clutter.
Q2: Can these clips be used on any surface?
A: For best results, these clips should be applied to clean, smooth, and dry surfaces such as desks, walls, and appliance areas. Avoid rough, dusty, wet, or uneven surfaces.
Q3: What types of cables can these clips hold?
A: These clips are suitable for managing a variety of everyday cables, including charging cables, USB cords, computer wires, and other similar small to medium-sized electronic cables.
Q4: How many clips are included in one pack?
A: Each pack contains 20 self-adhesive plastic cable organizer clips, providing ample supply for multiple cable management needs around your home or office.
Q5: Are these clips reusable?
A: While the adhesive is strong for a secure hold, repeated removal and reapplication may weaken its effectiveness. They are primarily designed for a single, firm application.
